packs.name: patchground-examples
packs.description: Curated examples shipped with the CLI; validated in this repository's CI on every push.

challenges.title: Last page of search results returns "page out of range"
challenges.summary: The catalog API rejects the last page of results whenever the result count is not a multiple of the page size. Find the root cause and fix it.

challenges.title: Cached profiles never expire while they are being read
challenges.summary: A TTL cache keeps entries alive when they are read, expires them one tick late and accepts nonpositive TTLs. Find the causes and fix them without changing write behavior.

challenges.title: Put a port between the order service and its storage and email
challenges.summary: OrderService imports and constructs SQLite and SMTP adapters itself, so nothing can be swapped for SMS or for fast tests. Introduce ports, inject the adapters and keep behaviour identical.

challenges.title: Report bad rows from the stock importer instead of stopping at the first
challenges.summary: A strict CSV stock importer aborts at the first bad row. Add a non-strict mode that returns the valid items and one precise error per rejected row, keeping strict behavior unchanged.

challenges.title: Duplicate charges after a payment retry
challenges.summary: A successful charge followed by a timeout causes a retry to charge twice.

challenges.title: Add unsubscribe and once to the in-process event bus
challenges.summary: A synchronous exact-topic event bus cannot take a subscription back or listen once. Add unsubscribe and once with precise snapshot, re-entrancy and error-collection behavior.

challenges.title: Release picker orders version labels incorrectly
challenges.summary: A release-tool library chooses the wrong latest version and misorders prereleases.
